desc: Derive and prove the full-rectangle formula `F(a,b)=C(a+b+4,a+2)-(a+1)(b+1)-(a+b+4)`; verified against tiny cases (0,0),(1,0),(1,1) and implemented with factorial/invfactorial up to `W+H+4`.

Formalize first-forbidden-vertex decomposition: forbidden vertices form one contiguous monotone segment; suffix after first hit is unrestricted (`start_count`), nonempty prefixes can only enter via left edge (`x=L`, needs `L>0`) or bottom edge (`y=D`, needs `D>0`); corner entries are disjoint.

Reduce all weighted sums to closed forms: `start_count(a,b)=C(a+b+2,a+1)-1`, `pref_start_sum(a,b)=C(a+b+3,a+2)-(b+2)`, edge prefix `end_count` via symmetry; independently re-checked the hockey-stick identities.
Boundary conditions handled cleanly: `L=0`/`D=0` skip entry loops, `U=H` gives `pref_start_sum(...,-1)=0`, `R=W` yields `a=0` suffixes; hole-at-corner case reduces to starts-inside only.
Assemble `answer=(F(W,H)-bad) mod 998244353` with normalized negatives; Sample 1 reproduces exactly (`total=431`, `bad=239`, `ans=192`).
Final program is `O(W+H)` time/memory with `O(1)` combinations, reads stdin and writes stdout as required.
